uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: Always — about/page.tsx, partners/page.tsx, and terms/page.tsx contain zero async calls, zero src/lib/api imports, and zero conditional branches. Each renders a fixed JSX tree (prose text, a PARTNERS.map() over a hardcoded const array, and Section components) synchronously on route mount. There is no fetch, no useState/useEffect data flow, and therefore no loading/empty/error state possible in this screen's own code.

notes.dataProvenance: static (per scan-map.json) — confirmed by reading all three uiFiles: about/page.tsx, partners/page.tsx, terms/page.tsx. dataFiles is empty in scan-map and no file imports anything from src/lib/api/ or src/lib/api/mocks/. All content (About's revenue-split prose, the ListRow links to /partners, /privacy/policy, /terms, mailto:hello@wawuafrica.com; Partners' PARTNERS const array of {name, role} objects, one role string using formatNaira(25000) for CAC pricing; Terms' full placeholder legal copy) is hardcoded directly in the .tsx files as literal JSX strings and one local const array — none of it is shaped as, or sourced from, a backend entity.

notes.authInference: All three routes live under src/app/(app)/ and are rendered inside AppShell (src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx), which wraps children in SessionProvider and renders the authenticated chrome (AppHeader/DesktopHeader/BottomNav/Sidebar) unconditionally — AppShell itself performs no redirect-if-unauthenticated check. None of the three page files call useSession, creatorGates(), or any auth/session hook directly; they only render ProfileBackButton (a UI nav affordance) and static content. requiresAuth:true reflects placement in the authenticated (app) route group by convention (consistent with every other (app)-scoped screen), not an explicit gate observed in this screen's own code — no role or creator gate is checked here at all.
notes.haltCondition: none — scan-map's description (uiFiles present, dataFiles empty, dataProvenance:static) matched the actual files exactly; all three pages read as described.
